title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next, 192K context on a 24 GB NVIDIA GPU
summary: Starting point for a 24 GB NVIDIA card with 128 GB of system memory. Still being tuned for this hardware.

tested_on.label: NVIDIA GPU with 24 GB VRAM (tested on an RTX 4090), 128 GB system memory

profile.description: Qwen3.8 Flash Next for a 24 GB NVIDIA GPU with 128 GB of RAM. Dense layers and the KV cache sit on the GPU, most MoE experts in system memory. 192K context with a q8_0 cache. Uses nearly all VRAM and RAM, so it runs on its own.
